strongs_1890.strongs_def: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.
